statement: Slot idempotency enforced on counterfactual_evaluations via partial unique indexes on (strategy_id, strategy_version, symbol, timeframe, decision_time) and (signal_id) WHERE superseded_by IS NULL.
Sequential rerun and concurrent evaluation job retry returns canonical evaluation record without creating duplicate rows.
Distinct candidate strategy versions (e.g. 1.0.0 vs 1.1.0-cand) are preserved as separate legitimate evaluations for the same candle close time.
Historical golden duplicate replay resolves 8 raw rows across the 4 duplicate slots to exactly 4 canonical records and 4 superseded records.

Slot idempotency enforced on strategy_observations via partial unique index on (exchange, category, symbol, strategy_id, strategy_version, decision_time) WHERE superseded_by IS NULL, preventing configuration_hash variations from inserting duplicate observation rows.
